title: RNA-Protein Interaction Detection \(RaPID)
protocol: Generate pMotif construct by cloning BoxB stem loop (GCCCTGAAAAAGGGC) adjacent to RNA of interest.
Plate 300K HEK293T cells per well in a 6 well plate on Day 0.
Transfect 2ug of pMotif plasmid with 0.3ug of RaPID labeler plasmid on Day 1.
Make labeling media by diluting 4mM Biotin to DMEM to create the working solution on Day 2.
Aspirate out existing media and add labeling media to each well on Day 2.
Aspirate out labeling media.
Add cold 1xPBS and gently mix.
Aspirate out 1xPBS.
Add 500uL cold 1xPBS to each well, then scrape cells and collect in individual eppendorf tubes.
Spin cells down at 500g at 4°C.
Aspirate out PBS.
Lyse cells in each tube with 200uL Lysis buffer at room temperature.
Add 20uL 25% Triton X-100 and mix thoroughly.
Add 220uL cold Wash Buffer 4.
Sonicate samples thoroughly - 10% for 10s. Ensure lysate is clear after sonication. If not, cool for 5s and repeat sonication.
Spin lysate at 15,000 g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Carefully transfer supernatant to 3K MWCO filter tube.
Spin filter tubes at 1500g at 4°C for 1 hour.
Pipette retentate into new Eppendorf tubes.
Estimate protein concentration in each tube and use Wash Buffer 4 to equalize concentration across all samples.
Label a new tube as Lysate_Sample after equalizing concentration, pipette 20 μL into it.
Calculate the amount of protein in each sample and determine the beads required per mg of protein. Use 50 μL of MyOne C1 Streptavidin beads per mg of protein with a minimum of 30 μL per sample.
Wash the MyOne C1 beads in Wash Buffer 4 twice.
Prepare fresh tubes labeled Pulldown_Sample, add equal volume of sample and beads to each tube.
Perform end-over-end rotation for 1 hour at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Place tubes on magnetic stand and aspirate out lysate.
Add 1 mL of Wash Buffer 1 to each tube, perform end-over-end rotation for 5 minutes.
Aspirate out Wash Buffer 1 after placing tubes on magnetic stand.
Repeat step adding 1 mL of Wash Buffer 1, perform end-over-end rotation for 5 minutes and aspirate out.
Repeat steps with Wash Buffer 2: add 1 mL to each tube, perform end-over-end rotation for 5 minutes, aspirate out.
Repeat steps with Wash Buffer 3: add 1 mL to each tube, perform end-over-end rotation for 5 minutes, aspirate out.
Place tubes on magnetic stand and aspirate out Wash Buffer 3.
Add 1 mL of Wash Buffer 4 to each tube and perform end-over-end rotation for 5 minutes.
Place tubes on magnetic stand and aspirate out Wash Buffer 4.
Add 40 μL of Elution Buffer to each tube and heat at 98°C for 20 minutes.
Run Western Blot for Pulldown & Lysate samples.
